draft.briefing: Hey, you're at Gokak Falls! This is where the Ghataprabha River drops over the edge, about 6.5 km from Gokak town.
draft.hungryLine: I don't know a named place to eat right here, so carry snacks. Gokak town is 6.5 km away if you want more choice.

moodReplies.show-me-around: The falls are just a 2 min walk from here, so start there.
moodReplies.somewhere-to-chill: Find a safe spot with a view of the falls and just listen to the Ghataprabha for a while.
moodReplies.surprise-me: Gokak Falls isn't just the name of the waterfall, it's also a small town of its own, run by the Konnur municipal corporation.

tips.title: Base yourself in Gokak.
tips.body: The falls are just 6.5 km from Gokak town, so it's an easy hop out and back.

tips.title: Keep back from the edge.
tips.body: Rocks around a waterfall stay slippery, so stick to safe viewpoints.

story.title: The river's drop
story.body: The Ghataprabha River flows through Belagavi district and tumbles over a ledge here. The waterfall took its name from Gokak, the town 6.5 km away.

story.title: A village by the falls
story.body: Dhupadal, the Gokak taluk village around here, counted 9,658 people in the 2001 census. Its women slightly outnumbered its men.

story.title: A town named for falls
story.body: Gokak Falls is now a small town of its own in Belagavi district. It comes under the Konnur municipal corporation.
